title: Natural Language Video Moment Localization Through Query-Controlled Temporal Convolution
venue_or_source: 2022 IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV)

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: # Abstract The goal of natural language video moment localization is to locate a short segment of a long, untrimmed video that corresponds to a description presented as natural text.
